text_block_list.name: Hello's Upperclassman
text_block_list.text:
Besides... Hello, do you know why they
started
doing winning concerts in the
first place?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Because runners wanted a chance to
express their
gratitude to fans after a
win, right?

text_block_list.name: Hello's Upperclassman
text_block_list.text:
That's right. We get up on stage and
sing to thank
our fans for coming to see
us on our big day, for
supporting us.

text_block_list.name: Hello's Upperclassman
text_block_list.text:
But actually, the true origin story's a
little
different.

text_block_list.name: Hello's Upperclassman
text_block_list.text:
One runner spoke up and said she
wanted to sing.
That's how the Grand
Concert got started.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: She... wanted to sing? But why?

text_block_list.name: Hello's Upperclassman
text_block_list.text:
Well, because song brings us closer
together.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Closer together...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
This song was sung at the first Grand
Concert to
bring people closer
together...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've been asked by Light Hello to
think of lyrics
for a song, and, well...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ooohhh...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Overheating detected. Should I pour
water on
your head?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
N-no, that's okay! My brain's just fried
from all
this lyric business—why is it so
haaard?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I knew a lot of artistry went into
lyrics,
but there's just so much we have
to think about at
once...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hmm...
choice_data_list: You don't need to overthink it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The emotions...
choice_data_list: How about listing out the feelings you want to convey right now?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: We want to convey...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I want to tell my fans that I've come
home to
them, and thank them for
waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Assembled Student A
text_block_list.text:
I want them to look at me! I want to
scream,
"Look at me! Follow me! Cheer
only for me!"

text_block_list.name: Assembled Student C
text_block_list.text:
And I want to tell them that I'm not
done yet!
That no matter how many
times I lose, I have a
goal, and I won't
give up on it no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Assembled Student C
text_block_list.text:
So until then, no matter what happens,
stay with
me—run with me! That's what I
want to say!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I... want to tell everybody that I am still
going
strong.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
And I want to convey my gratitude to all
who
look forward to me reaching my
goals, without
whom I would not be
running.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It would be the power to achieve a
breakthrough
for me, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, just how profound an
influence
concerts can have on
Umamusume is still an
unknown. Which is
all the more reason to have
high
expectations!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Then I want to tell everyone... not just
"I'm home,"
but also...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm able to run only because you're all
here with
me."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you all seem to be having fun.
How's it
coming along?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
That's good to hear. Trainer, about the
setlist for
the concert. I wanted to get
your opinion on—
choice_data_list: It seems things are going smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, I want the lyrics to have a call and
response
part!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This might not have much to do with
conveying
emotions, but I think a song
with some back and
forth would be
nice...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Call and response... a section of a song
where the
singer and audience shout in
turn.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me... a fan mentioned that
getting
to sing together was one of their
favorite parts of
a concert.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's so true! I mean, if you think
about
it...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We'll never be able to run alongside our
fans, but
there's nothing to stop us from
singing together!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we should propose the idea to
the others
right away.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's go see what everyone thinks!
We have
a bunch of new members too!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"We'll never be able to run alongside
our fans,
but there's nothing to stop us
from singing
together!"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Heh. That must be why the Umamusume
who first
created the Grand Concert
chose to sing.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Don't you see? She knew that song
brings us
closer together.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Okay, we may be in the final stretch, but
there's
lots more to do! We have new
people wanting to
join too!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Just one final push, and we'll make this
the best
concert it can be!
